title: SpaceX Has Deal for Right to Acquire Cursor for $60 Billion
title_zh: SpaceX 已达成以 600 亿美元收购 Cursor 的权利
summary: (Bloomberg) -- SpaceX said it has an agreement giving it the right to acquire artificial intelligence startup Cursor for $60 billion later this year or to pay $10 billion for the companies’ work together, part of the Elon Musk-run firm’s efforts to catch up with rivals in AI c...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——SpaceX 表示，它已达成协议，有权在今年晚些时候以 600 亿美元收购人工智能初创公司 Cursor，或者为两家公司的合作支付 100 亿美元，这是埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 运营的公司在人工智能领域追赶竞争对手的努力的一部分。

title: Vodafone offers small businesses cybersecurity, AI capability with Google tie-up
title_zh: 沃达丰与谷歌合作为小型企业提供网络安全和人工智能功能
summary: European mobile and broadband operator Vodafone said it would offer its ‌small business customers advanced cybersecurity and agentic ‌AI through its $1 billion strategic tie-up with Google Cloud agreed in ​October 2024.
summary_zh: 欧洲移动和宽带运营商沃达丰表示，将通过 2024 年 10 月与谷歌云达成的价值 10 亿美元的战略合作关系，为其小型企业客户提供先进的网络安全和代理人工智能。

title: How The Bread Financial (BFH) Investment Story Is Shifting With Mixed Analyst Targets And New Deals
title_zh: Bread Financial (BFH) 的投资故事如何随着分析师目标的混合和新交易而发生变化
summary: Bread Financial Holdings has seen its modeled fair value edge from US$83.53 to US$85.53, a move of about US$2.00 that captures updated assumptions in recent analyst work.
summary_zh: Bread Financial Holdings 的模型公允价值优势从 83.53 美元升至 85.53 美元，变动幅度约为 2.00 美元，反映了最近分析师工作中的最新假设。
